_: « Le monde de Krizaka : l'aube » / The World of Krizaka: Dawn — the treatment as data. Read by `orazaka cinema plan` (orazaka-cli, the shot-list planner of orazaka#259): every shot names its duration, lens, camera, light, air, action, the birds it holds (continuity references: each one's Mascot render) and the model that makes it. compose.py lays the birds (x = centre, y = feet line, h = height, fractions of the frame) on the canvas a keyframe re-lights. TREATMENT.md is the prose version.
title: The World of Krizaka: Dawn
logline: Night falls over the valley; one bird keeps watch, each of the others keeps its promise, and the flock greets the dawn as the phoenix rises.
style: Premium feature-film CG animation, real-world light and lenses, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flares, filmic contrast, fine grain.
music: epic modern cinematic score, felt piano ostinato and low pulse, building strings, deep taiko hits on downbeats, wide choir pads, rising to a warm triumphant major climax then a soft resolve, 90 bpm, instrumental
keep: One single continuous shot. The characters keep their exact cartoon design, proportions, colours and features, rendered as high-end feature-film CG characters with soft fine feather texture. Plain unbranded surfaces, no lettering.
keyframeKeep: Keep every character's exact shape, proportions, colours, eyes and features unchanged, as stylised cartoon characters rendered in high-end feature-film CG with soft fine feather texture, subsurface light and contact shadows. No text, no logos, no people.

falcon.en: The falcon keeps watch: security comes first.
falcon.fr: Le faucon veille : la sécurité d’abord.

owl.en: The owl reads every page and knows every face.
owl.fr: Le hibou lit chaque page et reconnaît chaque visage.

duck.en: The duck builds, line by line, in the open.
duck.fr: Le canard construit, ligne après ligne, en open source.

flamingo.en: The flamingo answers, and the payment follows.
flamingo.fr: Le flamant répond, et le paiement suit.

pigeon.fr: Le pigeon livre, à chaque fois.

characters.description: the orange-red falcon character with a black visor across its eyes holding two glowing cyan eye lights, small ear tufts
the violet owl character with two big round white eyes and pointed ear tufts
the crimson duck character with round glasses and a yellow bill
the pink flamingo character with a long curved neck and a yellow-tipped beak
the sky-blue pigeon character with violet wings carrying a small orange parcel
the green lovebird character with a coral-pink face
the slender pale grey crane character with a long neck, a long beak and a small red crown
the slate-grey magpie character with cobalt-blue wings and a long dark tail
the brown beaver character with one big front tooth and a flat dark tail
the phoenix, two flame-shaped wings, one violet and one gold, around a small dark body with one bright white core and a gold crest
